body:
### Problem

I encountered this issue while using rust-analyzer and used Codex to reduce it to the self-contained reproduction below.

If `codeLens/resolve` returns `ContentModified`, the code-lens provider leaves the lens unresolved but marks its row as rendered. The unresolved lens reserves an empty virtual line, and subsequent redraws do not resolve it again. The line stays blank until a new `textDocument/codeLens` request is triggered by an unrelated operation such as `:edit`.

Related reports cover individual parts of this behavior but not this failure path:

- #16900 and #16904 suppress `ContentModified` notifications but do not recover a failed `codeLens/resolve` request.
- #18008 and #28228 recover a failed top-level `textDocument/codeLens` refresh.
- #38153 ignores stale successful resolve responses.
- #38352 redraws after a request completes, but the lens remains unresolved.
- #38782 retains previously rendered text while replacement lenses resolve; on initial display there is no previous text.

### Steps to reproduce using "nvim --clean -u minimal_init.lua"

Create `repro.fake`:

```text
target
below
```

Create `minimal_init.lua`:

```lua
vim.opt.swapfile = false
vim.filetype.add({ extension = { fake = 'fake' } })
vim.lsp.codelens.enable(true)

local resolve_count = 0

local function fake_server(dispatchers)
  local next_id = 0
  local closing = false

  local function respond(id, callback, notify_reply, err, result)
    vim.schedule(function()
      if notify_reply then
        notify_reply(id)
      end
      callback(err, result, id)
    end)
  end

  return {
    request = function(method, params, callback, notify_reply)
      next_id = next_id + 1
      local id = next_id

      if method == 'initialize' then
        respond(id, callback, notify_reply, nil, {
          capabilities = {
            codeLensProvider = { resolveProvider = true },
            textDocumentSync = 1,
          },
        })
      elseif method == 'textDocument/codeLens' then
        respond(id, callback, notify_reply, nil, {
          {
            range = {
              start = { line = 0, character = 0 },
              ['end'] = { line = 0, character = 6 },
            },
            data = { id = 'lens' },
          },
        })
      elseif method == 'codeLens/resolve' then
        resolve_count = resolve_count + 1
        if resolve_count == 1 then
          respond(id, callback, notify_reply, {
            code = vim.lsp.protocol.ErrorCodes.ContentModified,
            message = 'content modified',
          }, nil)
        else
          local resolved = vim.deepcopy(params)
          resolved.command = {
            command = 'fake.references',
            title = '1 reference',
          }
          respond(id, callback, notify_reply, nil, resolved)
        end
      elseif method == 'shutdown' then
        respond(id, callback, notify_reply, nil, vim.NIL)
      else
        respond(id, callback, notify_reply, nil, vim.NIL)
      end

      return true, id
    end,
    notify = function(method)
      if method == 'exit' then
        closing = true
        dispatchers.on_exit(0, 0)
      end
      return true
    end,
    is_closing = function()
      return closing
    end,
    terminate = function()
      closing = true
    end,
  }
end

vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('FileType', {
  pattern = 'fake',
  callback = function()
    vim.lsp.start({
      name = 'fake-codelens',
      cmd = fake_server,
      root_dir = vim.uv.cwd(),
    })
  end,
})
```

A blank virtual line appears above `target` and remains blank. Run `:edit`; a second resolve request succeeds and the virtual line displays `1 reference`.

### Expected behavior

A failed `codeLens/resolve` request should not leave a permanent blank virtual line. Neovim should discard the empty placeholder or allow the lens to be resolved again.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

v0.13.0-dev-1168+ga85cce90e3

### Language server name/version

rust-analyzer 1.98.0-nightly

### Operating system/version

macOS 26.5.1 (25F80)

### Log file

_No response_
title: LSP: `ContentModified` from `codeLens/resolve` leaves a permanent blank virtual line
